items.title: NITI Aayog Meet: Jharkhand Seeks Centre's Support for New Universities
items.whyInNews: Jharkhand Chief Minister Hemant Soren met Prime Minister Narendra Modi and NITI Aayog officials on June 12, 2026, to discuss the state's development and seek support for new universities.
items.summary: The meeting was held at the NITI Aayog's 11th Governing Council meeting, where Soren discussed Jharkhand's plans to establish new universities with Prime Minister Modi and other officials. The state is looking to improve its education sector and boost economic growth. The NITI Aayog has been working to promote cooperative federalism and support state-led development initiatives.

items.title: Indian Navy Removes Unexploded Missile Warhead from Oil Tanker
items.whyInNews: The Indian Navy successfully removed an unexploded missile warhead from a Kochi-bound oil tanker on June 12, 2026.
items.summary: The Indian Navy's operation was carried out with precision and care, ensuring the safety of the crew and the vessel. The warhead was discovered during a routine inspection of the tanker, which was en route to Kochi from a foreign port. The Indian Navy has been working to enhance its capabilities and respond to emerging maritime security challenges.

items.title: 13th BRICS Urbanisation Forum Held in New Delhi
items.whyInNews: The 13th BRICS Urbanisation Forum was held in New Delhi on June 12, 2026, with the theme of 'Sustainable Urban Development'
items.summary: The forum brought together representatives from the BRICS countries (Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa) to discuss sustainable urban development and share best practices. items.title: Jaspal Rana Passes Away
items.whyInNews: Jaspal Rana, former Asian Games gold medallist, passed away at 49. He was conferred the Arjuna Award in 1994 and Padma Shri in 1997 for his contributions to Indian shooting.
items.summary: Jaspal Rana was a renowned Indian shooter who won several medals in international competitions. He was awarded the Dronacharya Award in 2020 for his contributions to Indian sports. Rana's achievements have inspired many young shooters in India.
